task: Get blaze's pinned LLVM onto a Linux ix VM
do: Fetch it by its hash from the release bucket crates/hir-ty-codegen/llvm.json names (release + '/' + targets.<triple>.name), check sha256sum against targets.<triple>.sha256, and unpack with --strip-components 1 into ~/.blaze/native/sha256-<hash>.
why: 60 MB in seconds; copying the unpacked 346 MB between VMs through the Mac took 20 minutes (records-6, edit2-3).
